purpose: Separate explicit perfect-Cauchy MC plus volumetric apex-flow experiment; not unchanged strict MC, fracture or scientific validation

sources.role: Classical MC SSR method; indexed D1 geometry dimensions, figure not freshly visually verified
MC MPM bridge; Table1 Section3.2 material inputs, H10m, slope26.57deg, independent SRFs and gravity loading

boundaries.leftRight: zero x nodal velocity, free y

initialState: zero stress/velocity; plasticity active; no elastic settle or reporting reset

numerics.method: native explicit USF/FLIP, 2D plane strain unit thickness

detectionConventions.cohort: fixed initial particle IDs with x0>2h AND y0>2h; same for both trials
detectionConventions.adjacency: initial-center distance <=1.01h within the fixed cohort
detectionConventions.movingNodes: dx>=0.25h AND downslope projection of actual displacement>=0.5h
detectionConventions.sustainedVelocity: component mass-weighted vx>0.001m/s for all saved states of some 1s interval; IDs remain the same over that interval
windowsReportedSeparately: 2-6s constant-gravity hold; displacements relative to saved2s
detectionConventions.runoutGateSeparate: at least1% initial total mass has center x>initial_toe+0.5h; also report front, median and centroid
detectionConventions.spatialMechanism: inspect actual scale1 geometry and plastic-shear localization; colour or scalar extremum alone does not pass
detectionConventions.integrity: stable IDs/count/mass, finite fields, positive J, constitutive admissibility, no center domain exit/hidden deletion/clamping; floor penetration invalidates runout
detectionConventions.stableControl: same cohorts/metrics/windows; no-damping ringing is permitted but must be distinguished from secular sliding

gatesBeforeFullRun: bounded genuine MPM updates with independent saved VTK/CSV audit
prohibitions: hidden SRF or parameter search after result
MC replaced by DP or VM without mapping
fallback/clamp or tolerance relaxation to make collapse
paper implicit steps interpreted as physical explicit time
scientific validation inferred from solver completion

constitutiveExtension.flowPotential: g_A=p; gradient I/3; lambda_A is plastic volume
constitutiveExtension.analyticDomain: Preserve strict elastic screen; mean_trial-p_A > existing_stress_tolerance/(2*sin(phi))
constitutiveExtension.remainingDomain: Unchanged strict projection including cap band/equality, admissibility and ambiguity rejection; no exception fallback
constitutiveExtension.strengthHistory: Perfect Cauchy strength; existing accumulated J2-increment history; separate actual apex multiplier
constitutiveExtension.work: Kirchhoff work=p_A*lambda_A; stored Cauchy plastic work increment divides by current J
constitutiveExtension.limitations: Declared extra volumetric tensile/apex convention; not fracture or a calibrated soil law; no guarantee of global instability

repeatPolicy: No SRF2 workaround; same SRF1.6 and all nonmaterial inputs. Confirm any integrity-valid coarse coherent motion at the same factor/model on h0.5 using the frozen common physical-metre observer.

savedApexObservations.active: VTK mc-apex-active-last is exactly 0 or 1; active=>lambda>0, inactive=>lambda=0
savedApexObservations.multiplier: VTK mc-apex-lambda-last is the last accepted native return, not a sparse-frame cumulative increment
savedApexObservations.histories: VTK mc-plastic-volume/work match CSV plastic_volume/plastic_work_pa, initially zero
savedApexObservations.stress: Active last return has hydrostatic Kirchhoff stress at J*c*cot(phi) within existing native stress tolerance
savedApexObservations.limits: Sparse saved data cannot reconstruct unsaved trial compliance or closed energy balance; point/native controls cover narrower identities
